verses.text: በይሁዳ ነገሥታት በኢዮአታምና በአካዝ በሕዝቅያስም ዘመን ወደ ሞሬታዊው ወደ ሚክያስ የመጣው፥ ስለ ሰማርያና ስለ ኢየሩሳሌም ያየው፥ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ይህ ነው።
እናንተ አሕዛብ ሁሉ፥ ስሙ፥ ምድርም ሙላዋም ታድምጥ፥ ጌታ እግዚአብሔርም፥ እርሱም በቅዱስ መቅደሱ የሆነ ጌታ፥ ይመስክርባችሁ።
እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔር ከስፍራው ይወጣል፥ ወርዶም በምድር ከፍታዎች ላይ ይረግጣል።
ተራሮችም በእሳት ፊት እንዳለ ሰም፥ በገደልም ወርዶ እንደሚፈስስ ውኃ፥ በበታቹ ይቀልጣሉ፥ ሸለቆችም ይሰነጠቃሉ።
ይህ ሁሉ ስለ ያዕቆብ በደልና ስለ እስራኤል ቤት ኃጢአት ነው። የያዕቆብም በደል ምንድር ነው? ሰማርያ አይደለችምን? የይሁዳስ የኮረብታው መስገጃ ምንድር ነው? ኢየሩሳሌም አይደለችምን?
ስለዚህ ሰማርያን በሜዳ እንደሚገኝ የድንጋይ ክምር፥ ወይን እንደሚተከልበትም ስፍራ አደርጋታለሁ፥ ድንጋዮችዋንም ወደ ሸለቆ እወረውራለሁ፥ መሠረቶችዋንም እገልጣለሁ።
የተቀረጹትም ምስሎችዋ ይደቅቃሉ፥ በግልሙትና ያገኘችው ዋጋ ሁሉ በእሳት ይቃጠላል፥ ጣዖታትዋንም ሁሉ አጠፋለሁ፥ በግልሙትና ዋጋ ሰበሰባቻቸው፥ ወደ ግልሙትናም ዋጋ ይመለሳሉና።
ስለዚህ ነገር ዋይ ብላ ታለቅሳለች፥ ባዶ እግርዋንና ዕራቁትዋን ሆና ትሄዳለች፥ እንደ ቀበሮ ታለቅሳለች፥ እንደ ሰጐንም ዋይ ትላለች፥
ቁስልዋ የማይፈወስ ነውና፥ እስከ ይሁዳም ደርሶአልና፥ ወደ ሕዝቤም በር ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ቀርቦአልና።
በጌት ላይ አታውሩ፥ በአኮ ላይ እንባን አታድርጉ፥ በቤትዓፍራ በትቢያ ላይ ተንከባለሉ።

O thou that dwellest in Shaphir, shame shall not go forth from thee; for the bitterness of thy heart and the evil of thy deeds shall not depart, and the dwelling of the house of Ezel shall be taken away from you.
Evil shall be far from the Lord, even unto the gate of Jerusalem; and in the morning shall thou dwell in goodness and be preserved.
O thou that dwellest in Lachish, thou art the beginning of sin to the daughter of Zion; for the transgression of Israel is found in thee.
Therefore, thou shalt give a tribute to Moresheth-gath; the houses of Achzib shall be a deceit to the kings of Israel.
O thou that dwellest in Mareshah, I will bring a conqueror upon thee; the glory of Israel shall come unto Adullam.
Thou hast been taken away from thee, and concerning thy children, make bare thy head, and cut off thy hair; for thy delicacies shall be like a mourning for a lion.
Woe unto them that devise iniquity upon their beds, and practice it when the morning is light! For it is in the power of their hand to do so.
They covet fields, and take them by violence; and houses, and take them away: so they oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage.
Therefore thus saith the Lord: Behold, against this family do I devise an evil, from which ye shall not remove your necks; neither shall ye go haughtily: for this time is evil.

In that day shall one take up a parable against you, and lament with a doleful lamentation, saying, We be utterly spoiled: he hath changed the portion of my people: how hath he removed it from me! Turning away, he hath divided our fields.
Therefore, in the congregation of the Lord, let there be no one who is found to be a deceiver.
They shall speak, saying, Prophesy not: let them prophesy not of these things; reproaches shall not depart.
O house of Jacob, is the Spirit of the Lord straitened? Are these his doings? Do not my words do good to him that walketh uprightly?
Yet lately my people is risen up as an enemy: ye pull off the robe with the garment from them that pass by securely as men averse from war.
The women of my people have ye cast out from their pleasant houses; from their children have ye taken away my glory forever.
Arise ye, and depart; for this is not your rest: because it is polluted, it shall destroy you, even with a sore destruction.
And the spirit shall be upon him; for concerning wine and strong drink, I shall speak unto thee a prophecy. If there be a man who speaks falsehood, he shall be a prophet unto this people.

O Jacob, I shall surely gather thee altogether; and I shall gather the remnant of Israel completely. As a shepherd gathers his flock, and as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, I shall dwell in unity among them, and their voice shall be heard above the multitude of men.
The oppressor has come before them, and they have been scattered and have not fled to the door; for he has also departed from them, and their king has gone before them; but the Lord is upon them.
Thus saith the Lord: O ye leaders of Jacob and ye princes of the house of Israel, hear me, is it not for you to know judgment?
Ye have hated the good and loved the evil; ye have plucked off their skin from off them, and their flesh from off their bones;
Ye have eaten the flesh of my people, and flayed their skin from off them, and broken their bones, and chopped them in pieces as for the pot, and as flesh within the cauldron.
Then shall they cry unto the Lord, but he will not hear them; he will even hide his face from them at that time, as they have behaved themselves ill in their doings.
Thus saith the Lord concerning the prophets that make my people err, that bite with their teeth, and cry, Peace; and he that putteth not into their mouths, they even prepare war against him.

Therefore night shall be unto you, that ye shall not have a vision; and it shall be dark unto you, that ye shall not divine; and the sun shall go down over the prophets, and the day shall be dark over them.
And the seers shall be ashamed, and the diviners confounded: yea, they shall all cover their lips; for there is no answer of God.
But truly I am full of power by the Spirit of the Lord, and of judgment, and of might, to declare unto Jacob his transgression, and to Israel his sin.
Hear this, I pray you, ye heads of the house of Jacob, and ye princes of the house of Israel, that abhor judgment, and pervert all equity.
They build up Zion with blood, and Jerusalem with iniquity.

Her leaders judge for a bribe, her priests instruct for a price, and her prophets divine for money; yet they lean upon the Lord, saying, "Is not the Lord in the midst of us? No evil shall come upon us."
Therefore, for your sake, Zion shall be plowed as a field, and Jerusalem shall become heaps of stone, and the mountain of the house as the high places of a forest.
In the last days, the house of the Lord shall be established on the top of the mountains, and it shall be exalted above the hills; and all nations shall flow unto it.

For out of Zion shall go forth the law, and the word of the Lord from Jerusalem; and many people shall go and say, "Come, let us go up to the mountain of the Lord, to the house of the God of Jacob; and He will teach us of His ways, and we will walk in His paths."

And He shall judge among many people, and rebuke strong nations afar off; and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruning hooks; nation shall not lift up a sword against nation, neither shall they learn war anymore.
The Lord of hosts hath spoken, and every man shall sit under his vine and under his fig tree; and none shall make them afraid.
For all people shall walk every one in the name of his god; and we will walk in the name of the Lord our God forever and ever.
In that day, saith the Lord, I will assemble her that halteth, and I will gather her that is driven out, and her that I have afflicted.
And I will make her that halted a remnant, and her that was cast far off a strong nation; and the Lord shall reign over them in mount Zion from henceforth, even forever.
Arise, O daughter of Zion, like a woman in labor; for you shall go forth to meet your King, the former dominion, the daughter of Jerusalem.
Now why dost thou cry out aloud? Is there no king in thee? Is thy counselor perished? For pangs have taken thee as a woman in travail.

O daughter of Zion, like a woman in labor, you shall go forth from the city and dwell in the field; and you shall go even to Babylon; there shall you be delivered; there the Lord shall redeem you from the hand of your enemies.
And now: Let it be desolate, for many nations have gathered against thee, saying, "Let our eyes see in Zion."
Yet they know not the thoughts of the Lord, neither understand they His counsel; for He hath gathered them as sheaves to the floor.

O daughter of Zion, I will make thy brass like iron and thy iron like brass; arise and thresh, for thou shalt beat down many nations, and their gain shall be for the Lord, and their substance for the Lord of all the earth.
O daughter of the heifer, arise now and gather your heifers, for they have troubled us greatly; the mighty one of Israel shall be struck down with a sword.
But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, though you are small among the clans of Judah, out of you will come for me one who will be ruler over Israel, whose origins are from of old, from ancient times.
Therefore, until the time when she who is in labor gives birth, the rest of his brothers will return to the children of Israel.
He shall stand, and in the strength of the Lord, in the name of the Lord his God, he shall shepherd them; and they shall dwell securely, for now he shall be great to the ends of the earth.
This shall be for peace; and when the Assyrian comes into our land, and when he treads upon our borders, we shall raise against him seven shepherds and eight leaders of men.
The land of Assyria shall be devoured by the sword, and the land of Nimrod within its gates; and when the Assyrian comes into our land, he shall be our shepherd.
And the glory of Jacob shall be like the glory of the Lord, as it descends from on high, like the dew upon the grass, and like the hope of man that does not fail.

Like a lion among the beasts of the forest, and like a young lion among flocks of sheep, who, if he passes through, shall tear, and there is none to deliver, so shall be the glory of Jacob among the nations and among many peoples.
Lift your hand high against your adversaries, and let all your enemies be cut off.
And in that day, I will cut off your horses from among you, and I will destroy your chariots, says the Lord.
I will destroy your cities of the earth, and I will lay waste all your fortresses.
I will remove the sword from your hand, and the warriors shall no longer be yours from this time forth.
I will remove the images that you have set up and your idols from among you; nor shall you serve them any longer.
I will tear down your altars and destroy your cities.
I will pour out my wrath upon the nations that have not heard, and with fury and anger will I deal with them.
Now: Arise, and before the mountains be scattered, let the hills hear Thy word, for thus saith the Lord God.
O mountains, and ye strong foundations of the earth, for the Lord hath a controversy with His people, and He will plead with Israel; hear ye the controversy of the Lord.
O my people, what have I done unto thee? And wherein have I wearied thee? Testify against me.
I brought thee up out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed thee from the house of bondage; and I sent before thee Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.
O my people, remember now what Balak king of Moab devised, and what Balaam the son of Beor answered him; consider the righteous acts of the Lord, from Shittim unto Gilgal.
Wherewith shall I come before the Lord, and bow myself before the high God? Shall I come before Him with burnt offerings, with calves of a year old?
Will the Lord be pleased with thousands of rams, or with ten thousands of rivers of oil? Shall I give my firstborn for my transgression, the fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?
O man, he hath showed thee what is good; and what doth the Lord require of thee, but to do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God?
The voice of the Lord crieth unto the city, and the man of wisdom shall see Thy name; hear ye the rod, and who hath appointed it.
Is there yet the treasure of wickedness in the house of the wicked, and the scant measure that is abominable? Shall I count them pure with the wicked balances, and with the bag of deceitful weights?
Shall I be pure, in the balance of the river and in the measure of the scales?
Their oppressors have filled them with violence, and they have spoken deceitfully concerning her; their words are treacherous within their mouths.
Therefore, I too have struck you with a wicked blow; for your transgressions, I have chastised you.
You shall eat, yet do not be gluttonous; your trouble shall be among you; you shall bear it, yet do not be overwhelmed; that which overwhelms you, I shall deliver to the sword.
You shall sow, yet do not reap; you shall gather your harvest, yet do not accept the oil; you shall gather the wine, yet do not drink the wine's juice.

I give you for destruction, and to those who dwell therein for plunder; I have kept the order of the vine and all the work of the house of the vine; by their counsel, you have gone forth, and you shall bear the burden of my people.

The fruit of the tree and the fruit of the vine, after they have been taken away, I have become as a withered branch; woe is me! A meal that is to be, my soul has desired, but there is none to be found at first, for it has been consumed.
Truly, man has perished from the earth; among men, there is no uprightness; all are engaged in shedding blood; and every man seeks to ensnare his brother.
Their hands are raised for wickedness; the leader and the oppressor seek their own gain; the great man speaks according to the desires of his soul; likewise, they conspire for wickedness.

Among them all, he is better, as he is like an amekela; he is the most upright, as he is like a pure vessel; your protectors have come upon the day that they shall visit you; now they shall be troubled.
Trust not in your neighbor, and place not confidence in a friend; keep the door of your mouth from her who lies in your bosom.
A son shall dishonor his father, and a daughter shall rise up against her mother; the daughter-in-law shall rise up against her mother-in-law; for the enemies of a man are the men of his own house.
But I will look unto the Lord; I will wait for the God of my salvation; my God will hear me.
O my enemy, do not rejoice over me; for when I fall, I shall arise; when I sit in darkness, the Lord shall be a light unto me; do not let joy be upon me.

I have committed sin against the Lord, and until He pleads my cause, I shall bear His judgment; until He executes judgment for me, I shall endure His wrath. He shall bring me forth to the light; I shall behold righteousness.
My enemy has seen me; and I, too: Where is your God, O Lord? She mocks me with disdain.
Mine eyes shall behold, for now as a mire in the way shall it be cast down. Thy wall shall be extended on the day it is built.
On that day, they shall come unto thee from Assyria and from the cities of Egypt, from Egypt even unto the river, from the sea even unto the sea, from the mountain even unto the mountain.
But the land shall be desolate because of them that dwell therein, for the fruit of their works shall be bitter.
Among the Carmel, only those who have settled there, thy heirs, shall be heard, as in the days of old, in the wilderness and in the glades.
As thou hast come forth from the land of Egypt, I shall show thee wonders.
The nations shall tremble, and all shall be afraid in their hearts; their hands shall be upon their mouths, and their ears shall be deafened, as the earth shall tremble like a serpent.
As the earth shall be shaken, they shall come forth from their dens, and they shall flee unto our God, unto the Lord, for they shall fear because of thee.
Who is like unto thee, O God, that pardoneth iniquity and passeth by the transgression of the remnant of his heritage? He retaineth not his anger forever, because he delighteth in mercy.
He will turn again; he will have compassion upon us; he will subdue our iniquities, and thou wilt cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.
From ancient times, thou hast begun to show thy truth unto our fathers, and mercy unto Jacob, and thou shalt perform it unto Abraham.
